title: Cow dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Dance floor / shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="90" rx="35" ry="6" fill="#2a2a4a"/>

  <!-- Back legs dancing -->
  <rect x="30" y="70" width="10" height="20" rx="4" fill="#f0e0e0"/>
  <rect x="58" y="70" width="10" height="18" rx="4" fill="#f0e0e0" transform="rotate(15 63 79)"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="29" y="84" width="12" height="7" rx="3" fill="#8a7a7a"/>
  <rect x="57" y="85" width="12" height="7" rx="3" fill="#8a7a7a" transform="rotate(15 63 88)"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="28" ry="20" fill="#f5f0f0"/>
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="55" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#7a6a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="62" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#7a6a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#7a6a8a"/>

  <!-- Front legs dancing -->
  <rect x="28" y="68" width="9" height="18" rx="4" fill="#f0e0e0" transform="rotate(-25 32 77)"/>
  <rect x="60" y="66" width="9" height="18" rx="4" fill="#f0e0e0" transform="rotate(30 64 75)"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="20" y="78" width="11" height="6" rx="3" fill="#8a7a7a" transform="rotate(-25 25 81)"/>
  <rect x="64" y="78" width="11" height="6" rx="3" fill="#8a7a7a" transform="rotate(30 69 81)"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#f5f0f0"/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="28" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#e8c8c8" transform="rotate(-20 30 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="28" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#e8c8c8" transform="rotate(20 70 28)"/>

  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#e8c8c8"/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="40" r="1.8" fill="#a07090"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="40" r="1.8" fill="#a07090"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="29" r="1.2" fill="#a0d0ff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="29" r="1.2" fill="#a0d0ff"/>

  <!-- Happy mouth -->
  <path d="M46 44 Q50 48 54 44" stroke="#a07090" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Horns -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="19" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#e0c080"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="19" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#e0c080"/>

  <!-- Head spot -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="24" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#7a6a8a"/>

  <!-- Tail with tuft, swinging -->
  <path d="M78 55 Q86 48 88 40" stroke="#f0e0e0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="38" r="4" fill="#7a6a8a"/>

  <!-- Musical notes floating -->
  <g fill="#ffcc44">
    <path d="M18 20 L18 12 L24 13 L24 21 Z M18 12 L18 9 Q21 8 24 9 L24 13" />
    <circle cx="16" cy="21" r="3"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#44ccff">
    <path d="M80 15 L80 8 L86 9 L86 16 Z M80 8 L80 5 Q83 4 86 5 L86 9" />
    <circle cx="78" cy="16" r="3"/>
  </g>
</svg>
